en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a large grave or burial mound in a park or wooded cemetery. The grave is covered with flowers, wreaths, and draped cloths or flags. A simple wooden cross stands prominently in the foreground with ribbons or fabric attached to it. In the background, many people dressed in dark, early‑20th‑century clothing gather and stand in lines, suggesting a public funeral or memorial ceremony in a city park or cemetery. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.
